findings.summary: Forbidden IPO functions modified and added
findings.detail: The commit rewrote computeIpoStatus, loadBistSymbols, reconcileStaleIpoStatuses, writeIpoToFirestore, syncIpoFeed, and syncIpoManual, and added archiveIpoItemsNotInFeed and syncBistStocksFull to functions/index.js. None of these were permitted by the fix plan. These changes must be reverted or separated into a distinct commit that goes through its own review; they must not ship bundled with the KAP fix.

The impl note file (.agents/tasks/kap-fix-impl-note.md) does not exist. Run flutter analyze lib/services/kap_news_service.dart and confirm clean output (unused-element warnings for _normalizeTime are acceptable; errors are not).
